title: Subscription Schedule
description: One run of recurring orders on one set of terms: a buyer-facing `description`, each order's `totals`, and when the run starts and ends. There is no recurrence vocabulary on the wire.

description.description: Complete buyer-facing statement of this run: what each order costs, how often, from when, and until when. Sufficient on its own; a Platform can render it verbatim.

totals.description: Breakdown of each recurring order, as a line item's `totals`, with exactly one `total` entry. Per unit on a catalog variant; for the line at its quantity on a cart or checkout. Before taxes, fulfillment, and fees unless the Business can state them.

starts_at.description: RFC 3339 date-time when the first order under this schedule is placed. Supplementary to `description`; omitted where the Business cannot yet determine it.

ends_at.description: RFC 3339 date-time after which no order is placed under this schedule, before the next schedule's `starts_at`. On the last schedule it marks a subscription that ends on its own; omitted there, the orders continue until the buyer cancels.
